systemsRuling.approvedShape: After a successful turn-0 RBiH identity player receipt, atomically queue exactly one complete existing rbih_paramilitary_policy_1992 decision before first Advance and resolve it through canonical event semantics.

findings.evidence: Electron reaches resolveEventDecisionCore and emits notifications; resolveBrowserEventDecision independently duplicates effects/flags/dimensions/receipt/causality and omits emitEventNotifications.
findings.resolution: Use one browser-safe shared decision and follow-on queue transition, or prove exact canonical full-state equivalence including notifications. Do not copy a second sensitive queue implementation.

findings.evidence: The generic IPC accepts arbitrary string eventId/responseId and the core checks pending ID and option but not ownership against meta.player_faction.
findings.resolution: Bind the timing transition to current canonical state, RBiH player ownership, War turn 0, non-headless mode, the actual pending identity decision, and a newly appended identity receipt; reject stale/cross-faction/non-pending/duplicate input without mutation.

findings.evidence: Identity resolution enables the policy event before the proposed queue validation runs.
findings.resolution: Resolve and queue on one uncommitted candidate and persist/broadcast once only after both succeed; any validation error retains the prior canonical state.

findings.evidence: apply_effects stamps expires_turn from state.meta.turn; moving the whole response to turn 0 changes persisted expiry and receipt turns.
findings.resolution: Pin turn_fired and receipt turn 0, ask recruitment expiry 52, allow recruitment expiry 52 and priority expiry 104, deny no modifier, with all flags/dimensions/causality/notifications applied exactly once.

findings.evidence: Retained evidence proves only two immediate no-player/player differences at Bukvik Gornji 2 and Obadi; it does not execute the proposed player branch.
findings.resolution: Require focused first-Advance proof and make no inference about seven January cells, score 707, turn 39/188, or calibration adoption.

bindings.requirement: Create one browser-safe shared owner for follow-on eligibility, validation, firing bookkeeping, and pending-decision construction. Electron and browser fallback must consume it, and ordinary identity/policy responses must use canonical event-core semantics including notifications.

After resolveEventDecision appends exactly one new rbih_state_identity player receipt at War turn 0 for the current RBiH player, validate and queue exactly one policy decision in the same uncommitted state; persist and broadcast once after both steps succeed, with rollback-by-noncommit on error.

Require player_faction RBiH, headless_scenario_auto_control false, matching pending-decision faction, valid pending identity response, enabled policy event, and a fixed policy definition contract: War phase, responding faction RBiH, requires_enabled/once/requires_player_response true, historical default always_deny, and exact authored option order always_deny/ask/always_allow. Reject all stale, duplicate, malformed, fired, closed, pending, decided, later-turn, non-RBiH, and headless cases without mutation.

Keep top-level paramilitary_policy ask and Advance hard-blocked before explicit policy response. Historical mode may mark always_deny as historical but must not select it. The IPC accepts only eventId and a response present on the current pending decision; no policy patch, synthetic request, spawn, target, or control instruction is accepted.

Apply the whole existing event exactly once and pin turn_fired/receipt turn 0, ask recruitment expires_turn 52, allow recruitment expires_turn 52 plus priority-shift expires_turn 104, deny no modifier, and exact flags, dimension shifts, causality, notifications, and receipt provenance.

Prove save/reload and duplicate-delivery idempotence before and after every option: one firing count, last-fired turn 0, one fired ID, one pending item before response, one receipt after response, and no duplicated effect or notification. Require byte-identical canonical serialization for identical logical input, including reversed object insertion order.

Leave event data, resolver option semantics, paramilitary detection/spawn/advance, War phase order, request/capture/control/displacement/casualty/war-crime writers, scoring, thresholds, references, protected controls, headless/no-player behavior, and telemetry unchanged. Do not tune downstream mechanics if either expected target does not appear.

Extend the focused RED/GREEN proof to compare Electron and browser canonical serialized states for identity-to-policy and all three responses, including notifications, clocks, receipts, persistence, duplicate calls, and hostile IPC. At first Advance prove deny/ask/allow semantics and only the exact candidate/capture OSIDs Bukvik Gornji 2 and Obadi.

Preserve n91-n95, all telemetry, reference/pin files, and protected controls byte-identical. The running clean b371adc3e full suite qualifies only that source; any implementation validation follows the already recorded cheap-first commands, caps, and stop rules.

Keep always_deny historical and ask/always_allow counterfactual; never frame allow or the two captures as optimization, recovery, stronger play, Historical parity, or calibration reward. This review approves no score, threshold, baseline, or adoption claim; any failed condition or scope change returns to the owner under Gate sections 6 and 8.

preserve: paramilitary sweep, phase order, capture, control, displacement, casualty, war-crime, and scoring semantics
